summary: Critical Metals Corp., a BVI foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing Amendment No. 4 to its October 24, 2022 merger agreement with European Lithium Ltd. (ASX: EUR), supplementing the May 18, 2026 binding Scheme Implementation Deed under which it will acquire all issued shares and listed options of European Lithium via two interdependent Australian schemes of arrangement. The amendment terminates Critical Metals' obligation to issue up to 6,778,838 ordinary shares as earnout consideration, and a Termination Agreement ends the February 27, 2024 Investors Agreement, both effective automatically on the Scheme Implementation Date. No price, premium, or close date disclosed. A separate settlement with a former financial advisor pays $5,000,000 cash plus about 1.1 million shares via Section 4(a)(2) private placement, with a resale registration statement required within 30 days and effectiveness targeted within 120 days — a resale overhang to watch, alongside Scheme condition and regulatory risk and completion timing.
